decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Drawings: [754-PL-001 Rev P1; 754-02 Rev A; 754-102 Rev P1; 754-104 Rev P6; 001 (Laserquest - Wandsworth Ground floor proposed layout); Reports and documents: [Noise Management Plan (prepared by: e3p, site: Jessica House Wandsworth,  reference: 52-082-R2, dated: 09/04/2026); Noise Impact Assessment (prepared by:e3p, site: Jessica House Wandsworth, reference: 52-082-R1, dated: 09/04/2026); Planning Statement (Ground floor Jessica House 191 Wandsworth High Street Red Lion Square SW18 4LS, prepared by: Jessica House Developments Limited, dated 02/02/2026); Operational and Amenity Statement (Laser Quest & Family Entertainment Venue Jessica House Wandsworth); Marketing Report (prepared by: Jessice House Developments Limited, titled: Ground Floor Jessica House 191 Wandsworth High Street Red Lion Square SW18 4LS, dated: 15/04/2026); Letter from Jessica House Developments Limited to Wandsworth Council (dated: 1/06/2026, ref: 25/P1628); Fire Safety Statement (titled: In accordance with London Plan Policy D12 (a) Jessica House- Ground Floor Unit (Laser Quest), dated: 06/02/2026)] 
. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) or any Order revoking, amending and re-enacting the Order the development hereby approved be used only for Use Classes E(d) and E(g)(i) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). In accordance with policy LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan.
Reason: To avoid loss of office space in perpetuity and to safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval and to protect Wandsworth Town Centre. In accordance with Policies LP33 and LP42 of the Wandsworth Local Plan 2023-2038 (adopted July 2023), in accordance with the National Planning Policy Framework
Condition : 4 - 4.Ramps and platforms not attached to walls
Any ramps or platforms should be securely fixed to the floor and should not be attached to, or otherwise come into contact with, the walls, in order to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration through the building structure.
Reason: to safeguard the amenity of neighbouring properties from excessive vibration and noise in line with Local Plan Policies LP2, LP14 and London Plan Policy D13.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of:
a) [1600-2000] Wednesday - Friday
(b) [1000-2000] Saturday - Sunday 
At school term times (which is defined as the dates agreed by the London Inter Authority Admissions Group (LIAAG) on a yearly basis

(c) [1000 - 1800] Monday to Sunday
Outside school term times (which is defined as the dates agreed by the London Inter Authority Admissions Group (LIAAG) on a yearly basis.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan  coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 6 - 6.Noise Management Plan
The development permitted by this planning permission shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved:
Noise Management Plan; prepared by: e3p; site: Jessica House, Wandsworth; reference: 52-082-R2; dated: 09/04/2026
Noise Impact Assessment; prepared by:e3p; site: Jessica House, Wandsworth; reference: 52-082-R1; dated: 09/04/2026
The mitigation measures shall be retained as such.

Reason: to safeguard the amenity of neighbouring properties from excessive vibration and noise in line with Local Plan Policies LP2, LP14 and London Plan Policy D13.

Condition : 7 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development the parking area(s) shown on the approved drawing(s) shall be provided and shall be retained for parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose. 
Reason: To ensure adequate arrangements are made for off-street parking in accordance with Council policies LP2 and LP51 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 8 - Prior to the first occupation of the development the cycle parking shown on the approved drawing shall be provided, and be retained for cycle parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for cycle parking in accordance with Council policies LP2, LP37, LP51, PM2, PM3, PM4, PM6, PM7, PM8 and PM9 of the Wandsworth Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 9 - 9.Waste Management Plan 
Prior to the operation of the proposed use, a Waste and Recycling Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Waste and Recycling Plan shall be implemented in full for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To ensure suitable delivery and servicing for the development in accordance with NPPF, London Plan (2021) Policy T3, T4 & T7, and Wandsworth Local Plan Policy LP2 and LP51.


Condition : 10 - 10.Fire Statement Compliance 
The development permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with approved documents:
Fire Safety Statement, titled: In accordance with London Plan Policy D12 (a) Jessica House- Ground Floor Unit (Laser Quest), dated: 06/02/2026)] 
The proposed mitigation measures shall be installed as proposed and retained as such. 
Reason: to ensure that adequate arrangements are made for fire safety in accordance with Policy D12 of the London Plan (2021) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024). 

Condition : 11 - Prior to the commencement of the use, details of a delivery and servicing plan including hours of operation shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.  The development shall be occupied and operated in accordance with the approved delivery and servicing plan.
Reason: To ensure that adequate arrangements are made for deliveries and servicing to the site and to ensure that the plan is sensitive to the amenity of local residents in accordance with Council policies LP50 and LP51 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 12 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
Condition : 13 - Informative: The sale or consumption of alcohol on the premises is not permitted as part of this planning permission and would be subject to separate licensing approval.
subdivision_of_building: Ground floor of the southern building.
description: Change of use of ground floor from Class B1A (office space) to Class E(d) (indoor recreation space)
